subject: Reseller invoice display and audit holdback routing — action items & redlines
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:12:00Z
Subject: Reseller invoice display and audit holdback routing — initial ops/legal sync

Hi team,

Quick summary: Nimbus has pushed back on our suggested wording for invoice "display" (their end-customer facing invoice) and a 12-month audit holdback clause tied to marketplace fee pass-throughs. Procurement flagged EU VAT flow and wants explicit language for invoice ownership and what evidence we must retain if there's an audit. They shared their redlines (attached).

Asks:
- Marissa: can you review the attached Order Form redline and confirm whether the proposed invoice ownership language is acceptable and whether the holdback clause creates undue long-tail liability? Highlight any audit evidence requirements we should accept vs. push back on.
- Karthik/Ben: please confirm operational impacts — who will own evidence retention, how we map reseller credits in billing, and whether billing display changes trigger product work.

Target: respond to Nimbus by EOD Wednesday with our consolidated position and a tracked-change Order Form.

Attachments: Nimbus_OrderForm_Redlines_v1.docx (from Nimbus)

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nimbus-systems.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbus-systems.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Reseller invoice display and audit holdback routing — initial ops/legal sync

Laura — thanks for the quick sync.

We appreciate the review. A couple clarifications from our side:
- Invoice display: Nimbus requires that the line item showing Redwood usage appears on the invoice presented to our end customers, with a clear label and the pass-through fee separated from our own margin. This is a strict marketplace requirement for several EU marketplaces we sell through.
- Audit holdback: we cannot accept open-ended retention obligations; we proposed 12 months to balance cost and auditability. We expect Redwood to retain proof-of-delivery (billing records, signed order confirmations, and SKU mapping) for that period.
- Evidence format: CSV export of transaction-level lines + an attestation letter at the quarter close is preferred.

Happy to jump on a call if it helps — Alex

Alex Mercer
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Nimbus Systems
alex.mercer@nimbus-systems.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nimbus-systems.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimbus-systems.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Reseller invoice display and audit holdback routing — proposed tracked changes attached

Alex / team — thanks for the clarifications. Please find attached a tracked-change Order Form (Nimbus_OrderForm_Redlines_v2.docx) and an evidence matrix CSV that maps the item types we can reasonably export. Summary of our position: 

1) Invoice display: we can support a separate line item showing Redwood usage and a labeled pass-through fee. We will not, however, be able to change the Invoice template per reseller — we will add a standardized label and a downloadable transaction CSV for each billed invoice. That satisfies marketplace visibility while keeping the engine single-template.

2) Audit holdback: we can accept a 12-month retention window for transaction-level records for audited deals. However, we need to limit obligations to (a) records generated by Redwood (billing CSV, usage reports, order confirmations) and (b) attestation statements from Nimbus confirming the end-customer relationship. We cannot accept open-ended indemnities or obligations to reconstruct third-party records.

3) Evidence format: the attached reseller_evidence_matrix.csv shows the fields we can export (timestamp, invoice_id, reseller_customer_id, sku, unit_price, discount, tokens, marketplace_fee). We can provide quarterly attestations in PDF signed by our Ops lead upon request under a mutual NDA.

Marissa: note the language at §4.2 (Audit; Record Retention) — we left in a carveout limiting our exposure to Redwood-generated artifacts. Can you review and confirm redlines inline?

Proposed next step: if legal is comfortable, we plan to accept v2 with a single minor edit to the holdback clause (clarify "evidence" scope). We can then issue an Order Form signature-ready copy.

Best,
Laura

Attachments: Nimbus_OrderForm_Redlines_v2.docx; reseller_evidence_matrix.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Reseller invoice display and audit holdback routing — legal comments

Laura — reviewed v2 and the evidence matrix. High-level comments below; inline redlines attached.

- Audit scope (§4.2): agree to 12-month preservation of Redwood-generated records. Strongly recommend changing the language from "upon request" to "upon reasonable notice (14 days)" for any on-site or deep-dive requests; this limits urgent operational disruption.
- Indemnity carveouts: explicitly remove any language that could be interpreted as Redwood indemnifying for Nimbus's failure to maintain its own reseller records or VAT filings. I added a sentence excluding third-party reconstruction obligations.
- Invoice display: acceptable as proposed. Add a short definition for "Invoice Display" in the Order Form glossary so there's no ambiguity in marketplaces that run automated reconciliation.
- Data retention security: require that any exported CSV is transmitted over SFTP or secure Drive link; don't permit email attachments for bulk exports. Add an operational SLA for evidence delivery (10 business days for standard requests; expedited requests subject to a fee).

Also flagged a potential regulatory risk for EU VAT reverse-charge flows — finance should confirm that pass-through labeling won't trigger additional VAT registration obligations in specific member states. Ben / Karthik: advise.

I'll attach the redline (Marissa_Redlines_091921.docx). If you want, I can draft a short email to Nimbus proposing the compromise language and the 14-day notice window.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@nimbus-systems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimbus-systems.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T17:05:00Z
Subject: Final position and next steps — Order Form v2 (ready for signature pending one edit)

Alex — thanks for your patience. We're aligned on the following path forward: 

1) Invoice display: Redwood will include a standardized, clearly labeled line item for Redwood usage and a marketplace pass-through fee. A downloadable transaction CSV will be available per invoice with the fields in reseller_evidence_matrix.csv.

2) Audit holdback / retention: Redwood will retain Redwood-generated billing artifacts for 12 months and will provide those artifacts upon reasonable notice (14 calendar days). We will not accept obligations to reconstruct third-party records or open-ended indemnities.

3) Evidence transfers: transfers will be done via secure Drive link or SFTP. For standard requests, we will deliver within 10 business days; expedited (under 72 hours) requests will require a nominal operational fee to cover expedited ops time.

4) Regulatory note: we asked our finance team to run a quick check on VAT registration risk tied to pass-through labeling. We'll flag back if there are country-level registration issues.

Marissa has prepared inline redlines (attached) with the above edits. If Nimbus is comfortable with the 14-day reasonable notice window and the evidence delivery channels, we'll produce a signature-ready Order Form with tracked changes and target signature by next Wednesday.

Please reply with a quick "agree" or questions so we can close this out. If you prefer a 30-minute call to finalize language, Ben and I are available tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Laura

Attachments: Nimbus_OrderForm_Redlines_v2.docx; reseller_evidence_matrix.csv; Marissa_Redlines_091921.docx
